redfin.remarks: Welcome to this charming and thoughtfully updated property offering a versatile living arrangement with a main home and a newly built, fully permitted ADU. The main residence features approximately 975 square feet with 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, complemented by a separate approximately 220-square-foot, 1-bedroom, 1-bath ADU—ideal for extended family, guests, a home office, or potential rental income. The main home features beautiful oak flooring , dual-pane windows , ceiling fans, tankless water heater and a mini-split system for efficient heating and cooling. The brand-new kitchen offers a fresh and inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. A convenient stackable washer and dryer add to the home's functionality. Additional improvements include a new electrical panel, copper and PVC plumbing, and a new sewer line. The permitted ADU is separately metered and provides its own private entrance and newly built deck, creating a comfortable and independent living space. The property also offers attic access for additional storage. Enjoy lovely views toward Los Angeles from the property, along with a good-sized yard featuring an impressive variety of mature fruit trees, including orange, avocado, loquat, pomegranate, lemon, guava, and fig. The gated front driveway provides parking for up to three vehicles, in addition to a one-car garage. With its permitted ADU, separate utilities, numerous recent improvements, desirable outdoor space, fruit trees, parking, and Los Angeles views, this property offers flexibility and excellent potential for a variety of living arrangements.
